description.p: PaTorrent (PatinaTorrent) is a lean BitTorrent client in the spirit of µTorrent 2.2.1: small, fast, native and comfortable with thousands of torrents. Its engine is a Rust port of libtorrent-rasterbar.

ul.li: Downloads and seeds over TCP and uTP, with HTTP, HTTPS and UDP trackers
Magnet links, DHT, peer exchange and local peer discovery
Encryption, web seeds, proxies, UPnP and NAT-PMP, IP filters
A tray icon, desktop notifications and Auto Shutdown

description.p: PaTorrent is pre-alpha: settings and saved state may change between versions. It is source-available under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0, so it is free for noncommercial use only.

Sonarr, Radarr and Prowlarr work with PaTorrent as their download client: seed limits arrive with each grab and Remove Completed removes finished torrents. Idle seeds keep counting their seeding time, adding a torrent brings the window forward, and a torrent added stopped reads Stopped.

The Windows GUI serves its own Web UI from Preferences, so a browser shows and drives that window's torrents. The daemon's Windows service command stores the Web UI login hashed and can replace and start an installed service in one step.

A search box that filters the torrent list by name, importing torrents from qBittorrent and µTorrent, security hardening across the engine, the Web UI and the remote mode, and icons beside the category list, the detail tabs and the Preferences pages.
First stable release. The window title and the tray tooltip show the version.
First pre-alpha build of the GTK GUI as a Flatpak.
